questions.prompt: After your turn, which passing lane is farther from F1?

options.text: The lane to teammate 1 through the middle
The lane to teammate 2 near the boards
Both lanes are equally far from F1

questions.prompt: Once 1 controls the pass, which space should 1 check next?

options.text: The netward lane where F1 is standing
Space beyond F1 that requires going through F1 first

options.text: No, F1 is away from that passing lane
